summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style scrambled harness (hex-mangled identifiers, per-function property-name dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated payload (rotated string/number arrays, hex-named identifiers, custom decoder function with a bespoke alphabet) that is not referenced from the package's TypeScript sources under src/ and has no relation to the advertised React Native / ECharts / Skia chart-rendering functionality. Using a downloaded alternate JavaScript runtime to execute the bundled opaque payload at install time evades Node-based tooling review. Both the loader and the payload are independently obfuscated.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
